objects.name: Analytic 2107
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to alarm configuration files on a Linux-based Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/alarm server by a User Identifier (UID) that is not the alarm management service, or the alarm management service process receiving Application Programming Interface (API) calls that suppress alarm classes without a corresponding operator session. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
